geometry.author: Tenmulate
geometry.notes: Original parametric meshes. The IOMEDIA viewer supplies reference views and image-map coordinates, not a reusable 3D stadium. No viewer images, brand marks or proprietary geometry are included in the runtime asset.

generatedTextures: Acrylic albedo maps use a fixed noise seed. Cycles ambient occlusion is baked into vertex colors. Seat materials, roof seams and score text are original materials/geometry, not imported imagery.
referenceUse: Architectural interpretation, not a surveyed reconstruction or affiliation claim. Court recoloring is an art direction choice and does not by itself establish reuse rights.
